summary.headline: DL E&C wins KRW 216bn public housing supply contract in Pyeongtaek Godeok project
summary.what_happened: DL E&C signed a construction contract with Korea Land & Housing Corporation (LH) for the Pyeongtaek Godeok A-69BL and A-71BL integrated private-participation public housing project, located in Pyeongtaek, Gyeonggi-do. The contract period runs from Nov 26, 2026 to Sep 30, 2030, and the project covers 1,995 households of apartments plus ancillary facilities. The filing states that the contract amount is DL E&C's 33% share of a total contract value of KRW 655.7bn (excluding VAT).

key_numbers.label: Contract amount as % of recent revenue
key_numbers.value: 2.92% of recent revenue of KRW 7,402.4bn (end-2025 consolidated)

summary.why_it_matters: Large construction contract disclosures in Korea generally indicate new order backlog for a builder, which can affect future revenue visibility. Under the filing's terms, amounts may change as construction progresses, and payment is made on progress billings within sales-proceeds limits.
